name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing himself, but through a deep fascination with the business side. After earning a degree in marketing, he initially worked for a technology company but quickly realized his passion lay elsewhere. He volunteered at local racing events, eventually landing an internship with a smaller racing team before making his way to MP Motorsport Junior.

Ricardo brings a pragmatic approach to his role, focusing on data-driven decisions and measurable results. He's known for his methodical planning and ability to see the big picture, ensuring marketing campaigns align with the team's overall strategic goals. His ambition is to elevate the team's brand visibility and secure key sponsorships that will fuel their success on the track. He excels in developing and implementing innovative marketing strategies, always striving to find new and effective ways to engage fans and sponsors.

Ricardo's strengths lie in his ability to identify and leverage the unique strengths of the team and its drivers. He has a knack for creating compelling narratives that resonate with audiences, helping to build a strong brand identity and foster a loyal fanbase. His approach to marketing is rooted in data analysis and a deep understanding of the racing industry, ensuring that every campaign is optimized for maximum impact. Ricardo is dedicated to helping MP Motorsport Junior achieve its commercial goals and solidify its position as a leading force in junior motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly athletic build, often seen wearing business-casual attire.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Insists on starting every marketing campaign with a detailed SWOT analysis.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk.
